bibliographic-data.invention-title: VORRICHTUNG UND VERFAHREN ZUR ERKENNUNG EINER BENUTZERINTERAKTION MIT EINER ATEMTHERAPIEVORRICHTUNG
APPAREIL ET PROCÉDÉ DE DÉTECTION D'INTERACTION D'UTILISATEUR AVEC UN DISPOSITIF DE THÉRAPIE RESPIRATOIRE
APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR DETECTING USER INTERACTION WITH A RESPIRATORY THERAPY DEVICE

nplcit.text: - JOHN B. WEST, Respiratory Physiology, Lippincott Williams & Wilkins, (20120000)

abstract.p: The present invention discloses an apparatus for supplying a flow of breathable gas at a positive pressure for respiratory therapy, the apparatus comprising: a housing comprising an outlet; a pressure generator contained in the housing, the pressure generator for generating the flow of breathable gas and supplying the flow to the outlet; a user interface; one or more sensors configured to detect the presence of a user in proximity to the housing; wherein, on detection of the user by the one or more sensors, the apparatus is configured to: enable and/or disable the user interface; and/or alert the user of the presence or absence of a releasable component.
